variants.prompt: On the dimly lit yacht deck, she reclines against the gleaming rail, her fiery locks cascading over the polished wood, as the stars twinkle above like diamonds scattered on black velvet. Her earthy-toned dress has been cast aside, revealing the tantalizing curves of her sun-kissed skin, barely contained by a lacy black bra and high-waisted panties. The warm breeze carries the salty tang of the sea as she raises her face to the night sky, her green eyes gleaming with a sense of freedom and unbridled desire.
